==== HOW TO USE ====
1. Make one reference image per character with the REFERENCE prompts (text-to-image).
2. Make each empty SET PLATE (text-to-image).
3. For each shot, make the START and END keyframes with an image-edit model: image 1 = the plate named in the prompt, then the references in the order the prompt lists them. Most local editors take only 3 images, so with 3 or more characters the prompt asks for ONE reference sheet with the others side by side (paste their reference images next to each other).
4. Generate each shot with the TAKE prompt in first + last frame mode (start = first image, end = last image).
5. Join the shots in order with hard cuts.

==== SCENE CONTEXT ====
A 15-second comedy short. One single continuous story.
A bright supermarket, late afternoon.
Two old rivals in wheelchairs spot the LAST donut at the bakery counter.
They race down the aisle for it.
A small kid takes it first.
NO spoken words. Only grunts, gasps, laughs and sound effects.

==== ACTIVE REFERENCES ====
NONE. Text-only generation.
The ART STYLE is fully described in STYLE below.
ALL characters, props and the location are defined below.
KEEP every design IDENTICAL from first frame to last.

==== CHARACTERS ====
AL — "THE RACER"
Thin old man, long nose, white mustache
RED bathrobe over striped pajamas
Rides a dented steel wheelchair
Personality: competitive, grumpy

ROSE
Round old woman, big purple glasses, silver curls
GREEN cardigan, pearl necklace
Rides a pink wheelchair with a basket
Personality: sly, fearless

THE KID — "BEAN"
Small child with a blond bowl cut
Yellow raincoat
Personality: calm, hungry

==== LOCATION MAP ====
Inside a bright supermarket.
One long aisle leads to the bakery counter.
ONE donut sits on a glass stand on the counter.
AL always on FRAME LEFT, ROSE on FRAME RIGHT.
The kid enters from the RIGHT at the counter.
A sign above the counter reads exactly "BAKERY"

==== SCALE LOCK ====
The kid's head reaches their shoulders.
The donut is the size of a fist.

==== CONTINUITY ====
Same location, same time of day, same light direction in every shot.
Character designs NEVER change.
Wardrobe and colors NEVER change.
AL's bathrobe stays RED.
ROSE's cardigan stays GREEN.
Only ONE donut in the whole film.
The floor is shiny white tile.

==== FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING ====
Wide view down the aisle.
The donut glows on the counter far away.

16:9 horizontal.
HARD CUTS at: 0:03 / 0:05 / 0:07.5 / 0:11.5 / 0:13.5
